## Download

**`FourvaleMultibox-{VERSION}-win-x64.zip`** below. Unzip it anywhere and run `Multibox.App.exe`. No install needed (Windows 10 1809 or later).

Windows may say *"Windows protected your PC"* because the app isn't code-signed: click **More info → Run anyway**.

Updating: unzip the new version over the old folder, or into a new one. Your logins, shortcuts and settings are kept (they are stored outside the app folder).

**Check the download (optional):** in PowerShell, `Get-FileHash FourvaleMultibox-{VERSION}-win-x64.zip` should print
`{SHA256}`

The app never plays for you: no automation, macros or input mirroring. Unofficial fan project; see the [README](https://github.com/Tusse098/FourvaleMultiboxManager#readme) for the play policy, testing status and disclaimer.
